name: 醍醐寺三宝院表书院
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a Fanggu heritage colored plate. Image 1 is the generated black line drawing and controls the exact building silhouette, openings and composition. Image 2 is the real monument photo and controls present-day materials and colors. Image 3 is ONLY the project colored-line STYLE sample, never copy its Chinese hall geometry or warm gold palette. Make a restrained architectural color illustration of the SAME exact building, with clean thin contour lines and modest natural material texture. The exterior canvas and all open spaces must be flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, ready for later local transparency preparation. No scene, ground, trees, people, cast shadow, gradient, paper texture, glow, checkerboard, text, labels, watermark or frame. Subject: Daigo-ji Sanbo-in OMOTE SHOIN, the ACTUAL 1598 main drawing-room building shown across the garden in the temple archive photo. Preserve long one-story tiled roof, projecting entrance/gable at one end, row of sliding doors and raised veranda. Isolate the architecture; do not substitute the Sanbo-in Karamon or depict the pond. Material observations: Weathered gray tile roof, dark brown cedar framing and doors, light cream plaster, warm wooden veranda. Keep color subdued.
material_observations: 按同主体实拍区分现状材质色，不推定初建时原色。
